explanation: It marks the July Revolution of 1830, which toppled King Charles X. Many assume it shows 1789, but Delacroix painted the street fighting of that same summer.

claims.text: Liberty Leading the People commemorates the July Revolution of 1830 in France.
Liberty Leading the People does not depict the Revolution of 1789, the Revolution of 1848 or the Paris Commune of 1871.
The July Revolution of 1830 overthrew King Charles X.
Delacroix painted Liberty Leading the People in 1830, the year of the uprising it shows.
